name: Vegetarian Lentil Couscous Stuffed Peppers

components.name: Lentil Couscous Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.name: Raw sweet bell peppers, approx four large halved and deseeded

steps: Preheat oven to 195 C. Halve and core the peppers, brush lightly with oil and pre-bake cut-side up for 10 minutes.
Rinse and cook dry green lentils in water until tender, 20-30 minutes, and drain excess liquid if needed.
Hydrate dry couscous in measured hot water and fluff; stir through cooked lentils, chopped onion, tomatoes, olive oil, lemon and oregano.
Fill pepper halves with the couscous-lentil mixture, packing evenly; scatter feta over each.
Bake another 20-25 minutes until peppers soften and filling is piping hot.
Finish with fresh basil and portion as two halves per serving; freeze without fresh basil if desired.
